At the national level in India, Pawan Kumar Chamling is the longest-serving Chief Minister overall [d1][d5][d8]. He served as the 5th Chief Minister of Sikkim from December 12, 1994, to May 27, 2019 — a tenure of over 24 years — surpassing Naveen Patnaik of Odisha (over 23 years) [d3][d2][d8]. Chamling was also recognized by the World Book of Records, London, for being the longest-serving Chief Minister of any Indian state [d4]. At the state level, different records exist: Sheila Dikshit is the longest-serving Chief Minister of Delhi with 15 years and 25 days (1998–2013) [d9], and Lal Thanhawla holds the record for Mizoram, having served five terms [d10].
